Name: Beloved Wretch
Description:
You gather twisted psychic energy around your hand and strike out at a target you choose within range as either a melee spell attack or a ranged spell attack (your choice). On a hit, the target takes a d8 of psychic damage, inflicted as conflicting thoughts of temptation and loyalty overwhelm their mind. If they are charmed by you or a creature allied to you, they take twice as much damage.

If this attack reduces a target to 0 hit points, you can choose to have that target quickly make a weapon attack using a weapon they possess against a target within range of it before they begin dying or are killed outright. This roll uses either their weapon attack bonus or your spell attack bonus (whichever is higher).
At Higher Levels: At Higher Levels. The spell's damage increases by a d8 each when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).
